title: 48 hours is enough: custom eggless cakes for Merrylands and Westmead
summary:
Two days is enough to build a cake from scratch — not two weeks.

Families in Merrylands and Westmead often assume a Saturday birthday cake needed booking weeks ago. Harris Park runs on a 48-hour minimum — that's what fresh baking actually takes, not what a calendar demands. Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Mango, finished in buttercream, fondant or ganache. Every cake is 100% eggless, so nobody has to ask what's in it.

Order by Wednesday. Ready Friday. WhatsApp +61 425 697 725.
keywords: thought a birthday cake needed two weeks notice
